prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic editorial portrait of an approved adult woman reclining naturally on a modern wooden staircase in a red satin dress.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long wavy dark hair and a soft neutral contemplative expression. She wears a vibrant red satin slip dress with thin straps, cowl neckline, and open back, reclining across wooden steps or leaning against wood paneling in a calm editorial pose; preserve the dress sheen and natural posture without sexualized framing.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical series portrait on modern wooden stairs, recessed warm LED strips, dark wood grain, subject turned partly away or reclined across steps, face and red satin texture clearly visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Moody directional warm LED lighting with soft shadows, elegant intimate cinematic atmosphere, realistic satin highlights and wood texture.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution photorealistic fashion photography, natural perspective, sharp face and dress, realistic skin and hands, subtle grain, consistent identity across poses.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-resolution cinematic fashion portrait of an approved adult woman with long wavy dark hair and a soft neutral contemplative expression reclining naturally on a modern wooden staircase. She wears a vibrant red satin slip dress with thin straps, a cowl neckline, and open back. Show a calm editorial pose across the steps or against the wood-paneled wall, preserving natural posture, realistic satin sheen, and dark wood grain. Use recessed warm LED lighting, moody directional illumination, soft shadows, sharp facial and fabric detail, realistic skin and hands, elegant cinematic atmosphere, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, logo
